dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software – system management information setting screen for high-cost medical expense drug classification (高額請求資料用薬剤分類情報設定)
purpose.summary: ORCGW16 is a screen-handling subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It manages the setting of drug classification information used for high-cost medical expense claims, supporting screen initialisation, input validation, DB lookup via MCP calls, and record registration. It is driven by MCP events (LINK, PUTG/CLICKED, entry) and interacts with the tbl_syskanri database table.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (56) for screen and data layouts
MCP middleware calls (DBSELECT, DBCLOSECURSOR, PUT-WINDOW) replacing direct EXEC SQL
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen navigation
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS – uses proprietary MCP DB layer
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding but were decoded as latin-1, producing garbled characters. Content is clearly identifiable as JMA ORCA system code. File is truncated at 16000 chars out of 38514 bytes; the procedure division continues beyond the shown excerpt.
